data.description: OsO₂ is Hydrophilite structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. Os⁴⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OsO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and four longer (2.01 Å) Os-O bond lengths. O²⁻ is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Os⁴⁺ atoms.
